analyst.summary: AIIL is a Dangi-family-promoted investment company (~Rs.15,600 cr portfolio, ~90%+ listed equities) that has built a distressed-asset NBFC/real-estate-resolution business atop the acquired Reliance Commercial Finance / Reliance Home Finance book, most recently adding the Creatoz Builders resolution (NCLT nod 16-Jul-2026) and a shareholder-approved MOA expansion into AMC/ARC/infra-lending. FY26 PAT fell to Rs.1,929 cr from FY25's gain-inflated Rs.4,241 cr, though Q1 FY27 (out 20-Jul-2026) rebounded to Rs.1,108 cr (+17.5% YoY); the balance sheet is very strong (0.1x gearing, 54% CRAR) and the legacy NPA book is fully provisioned (NNPA 0.9%), but the stock's ~3.2x price-to-book is rich for an investment vehicle with lumpy, gains-driven earnings, an unproven lending/ARC scale-up, and a promoter (Sanjay Dangi) with a recently court-rejected DHFL-scam chargesheet in his history.
